uncited: All methods in this family project 3D geometry onto 2D planes and aggregate the resulting fragments into a 3D voxel grid.
**Rasterization:** Triangles are rasterized into 2D buffers or directly into a 3D texture [3892-orthographic-multi-view-voxelization.md].
**Aggregation:** Fragments from different views are merged into the final voxel grid, typically using an atomic "OR" operation for occupancy [5300-3-pass-voxelization.md].
**Parameter:** $L$: Number of depth layers in the cost volume.
